html:
The Bindjali were an Aboriginal Australian people of the border country of South Australia and Victoria, on the map around today's Bordertown, in the district known as the Tatiara.

Little is recorded about them, and sources group them in different ways with their neighbours. These included the Ngarrindjeri to the west, the Ngarkat of the mallee, the Bunganditj to the south and the Jardwadjali and Wergaia to the east. Sheep runs took the Tatiara in the 1840s.
